property.statement: For x and y EACH in the64-dimensional repeated-column subspace IS (not merely x XOR y in IS), Pr[R4(x) XOR R4(y) in MI]=2^-32 for I={0,2} or{1,3}, versus2^-64 for a random permutation. Proposition1: the complete2^64-text IS populates exactly2^32 cosets of each of M{0,2} and M{1,3}, each containing2^32 ciphertexts.
property.quantifier: For all keys in the specified source weak-key class; not for all standardAES keys.
property.scope: Original AES key schedule only. Table1 intentionally omits distinguisher complexity; do not convert key-set cardinality into time/data.
